Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mostafa Ali 
Kheder tested by eng.Sherif Mahrous quality control general director eng 
Gamal Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and 
approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kureimat power 
station.
